description_en: Removes multiple hosts from an asset group at a time
description_zh: 从指定资产组中批量移除主机
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost remove-hosts-from-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --host-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveHostsFromGroup

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.
parameters.description_zh:
要移除主机的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。

parameters.description_en:
The IDs of the hosts that you want to remove from the host group. Specify a JSON string. You can specify up to 100 host IDs.

> You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to query the host IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
要移除的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多支持输入100个主机ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHosts](~~200665~~)接口获取主机ID。
